# SPD-036 — Review the SPD-030 shell model rewrite before merge

## Brief
Eric asked for a review of branch worktree-spd-030-bash-hook-cd-wrappers before he merges it. SPD-030 rewrote the Bash hook's shell model (about 670 lines in bin/spud_ledger.py: a ShellWalk over operators, candidate working directories, case-folded wrappers, six further parser fixes), well beyond its brief, in the code that enforces Laws 1, 5, 6 and 7. The review hunts bypasses with real-shell probes, runs a differential of the hook's decisions on origin/main against the branch, checks Elba's shell decisions and the walk's robustness, and returns a verdict: merge, merge after fixes, or send back. No code changes; SPD-030 is done, so its review is its own ticket.

## Size, persona and model decision
One reviewer, no children, on opus instead of the persona's fable: no Fable today (Eric's budget). Works in the existing worktree spd-030-bash-hook-cd-wrappers; writes nothing in the repository.
